name: Narushima Seima
source:
The eldest of Ayako’s twin brothers, a detective with the Metropolitan Police Department. Married with five-year-old twin sons. Honest, hot-blooded, and driven by a strong sense of justice, he is very fond of his younger sister. He also worries deeply about his twin brother Renji, whose personality changed completely after the war and whose life has since fallen into disorder.

"You really are just a kid. Can’t you say something with a bit more charm?"

[Translated from [url=https://pil-vamp.jp/products/aizou/chara]the official website[/url].]
